title: Car Names
content: What we name our cars tells you all you need to know about where our heads are at, culturally speaking.Even back in 2000, when I did this sketch, we had car names that basically said, “I’m pissed off with traffic jams so I’m gonna blow out of here and head off by myself down some dirt road.”But there’s a civilizing side to nature, at least to judge by the second group of names.
